title: Unique Crispy Canadian Portobello Mushrooms Skillet
description: A sweet and crispy vegetarian dish featuring marinated portobello mushrooms, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with the brightness of lemons and the warmth of Canadian cuisine

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced 1/2 inch thick

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the sliced portobello mushrooms to the marinade and toss to coat, letting them marinate for at least 15 minutes.
In a shallow dish, mix together panko breadcrumbs and grated parmesan cheese.
Remove the mushrooms from the marinade, allowing any excess to drip off, and coat each slice in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the coated mushroom slices to the hot oil and cook for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the mushrooms from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same skillet, add the maple syrup and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the syrup is bubbly and slightly caramelized.
Return the crispy mushroom slices to the skillet and toss them in the maple syrup glaze to coat.
Serve the unique crispy Canadian portobello mushrooms skillet hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
